fact: The World Bank project P165000 (US$23.5m, approved 2019-07-16, closed 2024-10-31) supports expansion and upgrade of Liberia's IFMIS; the page gives no date for the system's use, so the board-approval date is used.

The finance ministry, revenue authority and central bank state that the Tax Administration System records revenue and that LITAS is being expanded across regional tax offices, with an audit of 2018-2024 finding variances between its records and bank deposits.

The ministry states it is taking measures to integrate IFMIS with LITAS, SIGTAS, ASYCUDA, the transitory accounts and the General Revenue Account, treating IFMIS as an existing system; no date of use or coverage is given.
The Liberia Revenue Authority runs filing, assessments, payments and collections on LITAS, per its IT project coordinator Derek Hill.
